name: Brodee
bio: Brodee loves dogs and has been working full time at Silverdale Doggy Vacation Lodge since 2023. He is a self-motivated, quick learner and has completed Dog Handler Academy certification plus ongoing personal education on dog body language, dog training and behaviour. A few of his favourite reads are: The Dog’s Mind and The Forever Dog. Brodee has a special interest in canine first aid, health and grooming (having apprenticed for 6 months with a Groomer) and he does a fantastic job performing daily health checks on our pups. Some of his hobbies include playing the piano, reading and jogging.
